A '''''Consular''-class cruiser''' was used by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mavra Zane]] to transport a group of [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] to the [[Jedi outpost/Legends|Jedi outpost]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. She tested them during the trip by using [[Remote/Legends|training remotes]]. The cruiser also carried [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptors]] aboard.

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Consular''-class cruiser appears in the Jedi Destiny portion of ''[[Kinect Star Wars]]''.
